Discover "MAPLELATTE ANIMAL SHELTER SOCIETY" in Alberta, 🍁

Our mission is to provide compassionate care, protection, and second chances to animals in need. We are a non-profit, volunteer-based organization dedicated to rescuing homeless, abandoned, and neglected animals, offering them safety, medical care, and the love they deserve while they wait to find their forever homes.

Our shelter operates as a community of caring individuals — people who come together out of a shared love for animals and a commitment to making a difference. Every volunteer, foster, and donor plays a vital role in giving these animals a new beginning and a brighter future.
---
To support our rescue efforts, we offer services such as dog boarding, dog daycare, and cat boarding. These services help fund the food and supplies needed to care for our fosters.
